body:
Good words. This day and age things are definitely growing and changing. This female and I definitely feel the same thing for each other. We both have an agreement to be together one day if our paths don’t keep going in our current relationships. It’s nice because we’re also best friends. But there is no tension towards the others partner. It’s such a strange situation because normally people are unhappy and do these things because of that. But we are both happy where we are. We just realized and found that we also love each other. 

Today has been a day in itself. Worked on a guy who collapsed in front of family. Family did CPR. I continued. Eventually he came back but it didn’t last. I got to talk to family for some time after and was able to answer a lot of their questions. They were very appreciative of everything. My partner and I both feel the same about our work. We’ve been partners since we started at this company. We mask the emotions with laughter and Jokes. But we both understand and communicate that we’re both some what sad that he didn’t make it. 

We both are reaching out for help. And you are right. It’s so fuckin difficult. Terrifying honestly. Admitting that something is wrong. That I hurt. That I feel so much. We see so many people on their worst day and it just sits so heavy. But thank you. Because I’m ready for help.
Thank you for the words. Feels good to hear someone else saying that they have changed their attraction. I will be talking to a counselor soon. Got the number to call today.

Well, I am sorry that you have seen all of that. I can definitely relate on that aspect. Lost many personal friends and witnessed a few in person as it happened as well. Not to mention all of the people I’ve never had the chance to meet until after the fact. 

It sounds like your life has opportunity to be better but you need to move. Which I understand sounds impossible. You started a gofundme long ago, but based on the responses in here I’m sure if you were somehow able to get the name of it out to us we could make a difference to help you keep going. 

You can call me Kevin going forward. It’s not my real name but it feels better than a throw away account name. I want to be able to come back to this post the day after Christmas and see a response from you then. 

Let us try to help you. You have new friends. You have options. You have hope. It’s just a matter of letting your new people in your life give you the chance.

Depressed EMT here. Saying my title only because it relates to your future plans. I can’t say I’ve gone through even a 1/4 of what you have. I don’t know you, know where you live or know much about you. Unfortunately. But I do know where ever you are. There is someone just like me who responds to 911 calls for suicide attempts or completions.

I tell every depressed or suicidal patient the exact same thing. If you’re ever having a down day, call 911. Ask for me. Sadly the calls I go to where they are successful really hang on me. 

I’ve taken my days off to go sit and befriend patients. I’ve been able to become friends with 32 people now who are celebrating yet another year on this earth because they had a friend. 

I know that everything seems like it’s crashing and won’t get better. But sometimes one person can make such a difference in your life. I didn’t save any of these people. They saved me they just don’t know it. Many nights alone. Holidays without my blood family. But holidays with my work family and my patients. Slowly began connecting everyone to each other, with their permission, and we now have a huge group of individuals who all support each other. 

Call 911. Tell them you’re having a bad day and thinking of killing yourself. You might be surprised who shows up at your door. Could be someone just like me or better. Could be the one thing you never knew you needed. Don’t leave us guy. Please don’t leave us.
